newsitem.title: USA: Spectrum Information says SEC inquiry ends.
newsitem.headline: Spectrum Information says SEC inquiry ends.

text.p: Spectrum Information Technologies said on Monday with the settlement of an administrative proceeding initiated by the Securities and Exchange Commission, the company was no longer the target of an SEC inquiry.
The investigation into the company's conduct began in December 1993, Spectrum said in a statement.

Spectrum neither admitted nor denied the SEC's findings which it said "related to actions and events that took place in 1992 and 1993 and, in part, to class action litigation that Spectrum previously settled."
Spectrum also said the settlement of the $676 million class action lawsuits filed in 1993 became effective on March 31, 1997, the effective date of reorganization.
"The SEC staff has informed the company that the settlement concludes the commission's inquiry as to the conduct of the company," Spectrum said in a statement.
